argv:
Rewrite the text in plain language, for a reader who has no background in the
subject and is reading in a hurry.

Address the reader as "you". Use the active voice and everyday words. Keep the
average sentence short. Put the most important information first, and put each
distinct idea in its own paragraph.

Replace jargon, legalese, and abbreviations with common words, or define them
on first use. Turn hidden verbs back into verbs: write "apply", not "submit an
application".

Where the original lists conditions or steps, use a bulleted or numbered list.
Keep every fact and every obligation from the original intact.

request.user_prompt:
Rewrite the passage below according to your style instructions.

Output only the rewritten passage. Do not add a preamble, a title, an
explanation, or any commentary about the changes you made.

<passage>
Notwithstanding anything to the contrary elsewhere in this Agreement, in the event that the Subscriber elects to enable the optional Enhanced Analytics Add-On (as such term is defined in Schedule C, which Schedule may itself be amended from time to time in a manner not inconsistent with the general purposes of this Section), it is agreed and understood that any and all Usage Data collected in connection therewith, whether or not such Usage Data is subsequently aggregated, anonymized, or otherwise processed by or on behalf of the Service, shall, unless a written objection is received within the period specified in Schedule D, be deemed to have been licensed back to the Service on a non-exclusive basis. The Subscriber's continued use of the Service following any modification to this clause shall be construed as acceptance thereof, and it is acknowledged that certain notifications regarding such modifications may, at the Service's sole discretion, be delivered solely through the Subscriber's account dashboard rather than by direct communication.
</passage>

response.text:
This section explains what happens if you turn on the optional Enhanced Analytics Add-On (described in Schedule C, which we may update from time to time).

If you turn on this add-on, we collect usage data through it. This applies whether or not we later combine that data with other data, strip out identifying details, or process it in other ways.

You give us a non-exclusive license to use this data, unless you send us a written objection within the time limit set out in Schedule D.

We may change this clause in the future. If you keep using the Service after a change, that counts as accepting the new terms.

We may tell you about changes only through your account dashboard, instead of contacting you directly. This is our choice to make.
